title: AC Python Plugin Skeleton
description: Bootstrap the proprietary PRISM plugin for hyperMILL via the Automation Center (AC) Python API. Registers the plugin in AC Plugin Manager with 5 toolbar buttons (Physics Advisor, Quality Gate, Post Enhancer, Tool Crib, Learning Dashboard). Establishes the HTTP client layer to PRISM MCP Server at localhost:18361 with TLS. Builds the panel hosting framework using AC's HTML/JS custom panel support inside hyperCAD-S.

forge_triple.action: hypermill_plugin:register_plugin — BUILT (registers PRISM add-in in AC Plugin Manager)
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-plugin-status — DECLARED (check plugin registration and connection status)

sessions.title: Plugin Registration + HTTP Client
sessions.intent: Generate the AC Python plugin skeleton that registers in hyperMILL's Plugin Manager with 5 toolbar buttons, and establish the HTTP client to PRISM MCP server with TLS on localhost:18361.

units.title: AC Plugin Registration + Toolbar Buttons
units.description: Generate the AC Python add-in entry point using HyperMillACAddInGenerator. Register 5 toolbar buttons (Physics Advisor, Quality Gate, Post Enhancer, Tool Crib, Learning Dashboard) in AC Plugin Manager. Configure plugin metadata (name, version, author, icon). Validate plugin appears in hyperMILL's add-in list.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Plugin entry point generated as compiled .pyc with AC-compliant structure
5 toolbar buttons registered with unique IDs, icons, and callback handlers
Plugin metadata (name='PRISM', version, author) correctly set in AC manifest

units.title: HTTP Client to PRISM MCP Server
units.description: Build the Python HTTP client layer that connects the plugin to PRISM MCP server at localhost:18361. Implement TLS certificate pinning for localhost communication. Add connection health check, retry logic with exponential backoff, and timeout handling. Build request/response serialization for PRISM dispatcher actions.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: HTTP client connects to localhost:18361 with TLS certificate validation
Retry logic with exponential backoff (3 retries, 1s/2s/4s) implemented
Request serialization matches PRISM dispatcher action schema (action, params, context)

sessions.exit_gate: Plugin registers in AC + HTTP client connects to PRISM | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: Panel Hosting Framework + Plugin Distribution
sessions.intent: Build the HTML/JS panel hosting framework inside hyperCAD-S and create the signed .zip distribution package with compiled Python.

units.title: HTML/JS Panel Hosting Framework
units.description: Build the panel hosting infrastructure that loads HTML/JS panels inside hyperCAD-S. Implement panel lifecycle management (open, close, resize, dock). Create base panel template with PRISM branding, common CSS, and shared JavaScript utilities. Build message bridge between Python plugin backend and HTML/JS panel frontend via AC's postMessage API.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Base HTML panel loads inside hyperCAD-S with PRISM branding and responsive layout
Python↔JS message bridge operational via AC postMessage API
Panel lifecycle (open/close/dock/resize) handled without memory leaks

units.title: Plugin Distribution Package + Compilation
units.description: Create the plugin distribution pipeline: compile Python to .pyc (or Cython .pyd for critical modules), bundle HTML/JS/CSS assets, create signed .zip package. Implement version checking and auto-update notification. Build installation script that registers the plugin in AC Plugin Manager.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Python source compiled to .pyc with no readable source in distribution
Signed .zip package created with manifest, assets, and compiled code
Installation script registers plugin in AC Plugin Manager on first run

sessions.exit_gate: Panel framework loads in hyperCAD-S + distribution .zip builds cleanly | omega_floor >= 0.90
